class.name: GameplayPlayerState
class.brief_description: Persistent player identity and match state independent from a pawn.
class.description: GameplayPlayerState stores stable user, session, and peer identity across pawn replacement. It may be retained when a controller disconnects and later rebound. Match-wide registration is maintained by [GameplayGameState].

method.name: activate
method.description: Marks the state active for the given connection identity.

method.name: copy_identity_to
method.description: Copies user, session, peer, and active connection identity to [param target]. Controller and game-state relationships are not copied.

method.name: deactivate
method.description: Marks the state inactive and clears its peer ID while preserving stable identity.

method.name: get_game_state
method.description: Returns the match state that contains this player, or [code]null[/code].

members.member: The current multiplayer peer identity, or [code]0[/code] when inactive.

signal.name: activated
signal.description: Emitted when the player becomes active.

signal.name: controller_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the controller relationship changes.

signal.name: deactivated
signal.description: Emitted when the player becomes inactive.
